entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This place seems to be[n]bustling. Chicken stock light[n]soy sauce-flavored soup...?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I've never found light[n]ramen to be particularly[n]satisfying though...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Anyway... shall we get in line?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I was ignorant of the possibilities[n]of this world... To think light[n]ramen could hold so much depth...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The gentle, yet fragrant flavor[n]explodes in my mouth... The superb[n]noodles warm my soul...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This harmony of flavor was truly[n]memorable...! It is an incredible[n]way to replenish nutrients!
You should be a food critic.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes. I always endeavor to consume[n]a frugal diet, so a cheap yet[n]nutrient-rich meal is a godsend.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: My main staple is bean sprouts.[n]They are cheap, delicious, and[n]utterly packed with fiber.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What is so wrong with expressing[n]my joy!? Food and art fulfill[n]similar roles in life...!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Praising things which you like[n]is important, you know.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah, that would truly be the ideal[n]part-time job! I could be paid[n]and save on food costs...!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I doubt that I would be[n]qualified though...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No matter. This was an exceedingly[n]delicious meal! Thank you for[n]bringing me out here.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I feel as though I will be able[n]to continue performing my best[n]from this point forward.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I must get home and begin[n]painting while I am still full!
